title: Home services and trades (plumber, roofer, HVAC, electrician, painter, landscaper, cleaner)
basis: Recalled general knowledge, 2026-10-22; hosts not re-fetched (UNVERIFIED). Lead marketplaces (Angi, HomeAdvisor, Thumbtack) sell leads: a profile is free to hold but the leads cost money; the pack marks them so.

domainTypes.note: lead marketplace: check the cost per lead first
lead marketplace, same owner family as Angi
project photos with a website link; good for remodelers and designers
home builders: local builders associations list members

patterns.why: a home show or builders association

angles: Apply for the 'certified installer' or 'find a pro' locator of each manufacturer whose product you install; they link to local contractors and send calls.
Join the trade association and the local builders or contractors association; fill the member profile.
Publish before-and-after project pages with the street or neighbourhood, and give them to the local news site and the neighbourhood group.
Ask your suppliers and your showroom partners for a 'where to buy / who installs' entry.
Sponsor a local team or home show booth; ask for the sponsor-page link.
Collect reviews on Google first; on the lead marketplaces only if the client chose to buy leads there.
avoid: Keyword-stuffed business names on listings ('Best Plumber Sacramento'): it breaks consistency and the platforms' rules.
Fake 'office addresses' in each city (virtual offices, mailbox addresses) to enter more map packs.
Doorway city pages with the same text and a different city name.
Paying for links on 'contractor SEO' blog networks.
